entities.name: Kinesis (Ingestion)
entities.rationale: Kinesis stream icon on the top-left labeled KINESIS, receiving account update events.

entities.name: Lambda (Batching)
entities.rationale: Lambda icon in the top-center labeled LAMBDA, reads transaction data from RDS and batches messages.

entities.name: RDS (Transactions)
entities.rationale: RDS icon on the top-right labeled RDS, storing imported banking transaction data.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: SQS icon in the center labeled SQS, buffering batches of transactions for parallel processing.

entities.name: Lambda (NLP)
entities.rationale: Lambda icon in the lower-center labeled LAMBDA, scaling out to perform natural language processing on transaction strings.

entities.name: RDS (Enriched)
entities.rationale: RDS icon on the bottom-left labeled RDS, where enriched processed transactions and model versions are saved.

entities.name: Kinesis (Processed)
entities.rationale: Kinesis icon on the bottom-right labeled KINESIS, publishing completion events to trigger downstream services.

visual_connections.description: Sends account update event to trigger the batching Lambda function.
Lambda queries transaction records from RDS.
Pushes batches of transaction descriptions into the SQS queue.
Fans out batched transaction strings across multiple NLP Lambda workers.
Persists parsed and enriched transaction data into RDS.
Emits processed completion events to Kinesis.
